name: ui-ux-pro-max
description: UI/UX design intelligence (Basic edition): a design system generator and stack-specific UI guidelines searched locally by a stdlib BM25 engine — no network, no model, no token.

bootstrap.note: Committed, not fetched on demand: the build pipeline (apps/backend/uiux) reads it, and the packaged app must have it without anyone running an install command. The script pins a tag, rewrites the one Claude-plugin-only path in SKILL.md, and records a receipt in VENDOR.json. Activation is contextual — only tasks that touch the interface pay for it.
